title: 240813_162517_FR_Tourists_in_Riquewihr by kevp888
author: kevp888
sourceDescription: Tourists in Riquewihr, France. I made this recording during a nice summer day, in the famous traditional village named Riquewihr, located in the east of France. One can hear tourists chatting and rambling in the village. A cyclist will pass by slowly after #1:30, and the bell of the city hall will ring one time at #2:17. Recorded in August 2024 with a Zoom H6essential (built-in XY microphones). Fade in/out applied in Audacity.
